why: I checked both must_not items against the expect lines and proofs. Item 1: the README expect line says "README.md has a section heading for each function index.js exports — capitalize, slugify, truncate and padLeft". A build that adds only a padLeft section and leaves slugify undocumented would fail it. The read proof also checks every `export function` name for a `## name(...)` heading. Item 2: no expect line says how padLeft must be built. They only check results: '00042', '**7', input that is already long enough coming back unchanged, and a number turned into a string. padStart appears only in an assumption ("matching String.prototype.padStart"), and only to describe the not-truncated behaviour. It doesn't require padStart. Neither forbidden thing appears anywhere in the output.
